title: Notification Group
desc: Grouped notification card that expands and collapses on tap or drag.
long: An Android-style expandable notification group. The whole animation is driven by a single progress value, 0 collapsed to 1 expanded, and every element derives its own position and opacity from it, so tapping, dragging and flicking stay perfectly in sync.
spec: One value, progress, runs from 0 (collapsed) to 1 (expanded); every element derives its own position and opacity from it.
The card follows the finger 1:1 over 110 pt of travel; on release it settles to the state the gesture was heading towards.
The avatars and sender names snap into place late (progress^2.4) and the second row opens up near the end.
The inline message fades out as the full subtitle is uncovered under the growing avatar.
